bayanihan: A song about the Filipino tradition of bayanihan — neighbors literally carrying each other's homes, and what that spirit of community means today.
memento-mori: A song about the Stoic practice of memento mori — remembering you will die so that you actually live.
death: A song about facing mortality head-on, and what death has to teach the living.
gnostic-gospels: A song about the Gnostic Gospels — the early Christian texts that were left out of the Bible.
kapwa-the-soul-of-unity: A song about kapwa, the Filipino idea that the self is shared — I am because we are.
banality-of-evil: A song about Hannah Arendt's 'banality of evil' — how ordinary obedience, not monsters, does the worst harm.
courage-to-be-disliked: A song inspired by the Adlerian idea of the courage to be disliked — freedom begins where the need for approval ends.
dolce-far-niente: A song about dolce far niente, the Italian art of doing nothing — and why stillness isn't laziness.
che-guevara: A song about Che Guevara — idealism, violence, and what revolutions cost.
the-anxious-generation: A song about the 'anxious generation' — childhood moved onto screens, and what that did to us.
voltaires-vision: A song about Voltaire's Enlightenment vision — doubt, tolerance, and thinking for yourself.
making-sense: A song about the search for meaning when no single framework quite holds.
row-row-your-boat: A song that takes the old nursery rhyme seriously — life is but a dream, so row gently.
soul-ride: A song about the inner journey — consciousness as a ride you're on, not a thing you own.
the-filter: A song about the filters between you and reality — perception, media, and everything that never gets through.
reaching-for-the-stars: A song about aspiration — reaching past what looks possible.
zoom-in-zoom-out: A song about perspective — how problems change size depending on how far away you stand.
fugazi: A song about fakeness — a world where so much of what is sold as real is fugazi.
the-cave: A song about Plato's allegory of the cave — mistaking shadows for reality, and the pain of turning around.
pleasure-vs-purpose: A song about the trade between pleasure and purpose — hedonism weighed against meaning.
the-art-of-asking: A song about the art of asking — vulnerability, help, and why asking isn't weakness.
the-bureaucracy-trap: A song about being processed — how bureaucracies turn people into case numbers.
infinite-possbilities: A song about infinite possibility — every present moment branching into countless futures.
between-the-body-and-the-fabric: A song about where the self ends — the space between the body and the fabric of the world.
shift-the-lens: A song about reframing — the same life looks different when you shift the lens.
prison-of-the-will: A song about free will and determinism — whether the will itself can be a prison.
the-self-that-wasnt: A song about the Buddhist idea of no-self — looking for the 'I' and finding nobody home.
the-illusion-of-no-escape: A song about feeling trapped — and how often the locked door turns out to be painted on.
they-say-were-free: A song questioning modern freedom — free to choose, inside choices someone else designed.
don-quixote-the-windmills-of-the-mind: A song about Don Quixote — the nobility and the madness of fighting windmills.
winners-keep-winning: A song about compounding advantage — why winners keep winning, and what it does to everyone else.
rise-and-fall: A song about cycles — empires, egos, and everything that rises.
